initialChromeFixture.reason: Harness waited on MessagePort although actual Worker replies through event.source. Confirmed live owned browser stopped to settle the blocked caller. No image request occurred. Subsequent fixture uses actual message listener and a bounded 5s handshake; not a product-network failure.

initialRegressionFix: Three legacy header timing/coalescing checks failed and two cancelled because a newly added microtask deferred even idle admission. Immediate async source dispatch restored prior ordering without changing source timeouts. Eleven locale inventory assertions required the nine explicit new keys; all original keys remain checked.
